system.description:
Range 30ft; casting takes 1 hour. One willing dead creature, dead no longer than 200 years per level, even if no body remains: you must know its name or hold a piece of its body, and a new body forms. It returns at full HP with no Exhaustion, no Constitution loss and no other penalty, even if it died of old age (it returns in the prime of its life). No save. Material: diamond dust worth 25,000 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric
